_comments: The BizApps Credentialing Application — what puts Credentialing in the MemberJunction Explorer app switcher.
ClassName selects CredentialingApplication (@mj-biz-apps/credentialing-ng), which builds the nav items per user
from their roles (Staff: Program Studio / organization setup; Review: Assignments; Applicant: My Applications).
DefaultNavItems holds only the Applicant item and is used only when that class is not loaded.
Each item is ResourceType Custom pointing at a DriverClass registered with

fields.Name: Credentialing
fields.Description: Credentialing, certification, and licensure management for MemberJunction: credential definitions, requirements, holder records, verification, expiration and renewal cycles.
